240-5470-8095-8296.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat from step 2.

2478-2866-4986-8095.description:
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

301-2646-4738.description:
Activate Goblin Sledder by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Resolve the Goblin Sledder ability.
Repeat.

443-1263-4871-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Magus of the Bridge trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4050-7084-7705.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Phyrexian Altar ability.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Mole Man triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

2267-2438-3240-6462.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Tormod triggers, creating a Treasure token and creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1806-2034-4871-7499.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
When Eternal Scourge dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B/G}.
Activate Lluwen by exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, causing Lluwen to become prepared.
Cast a copy of Pest Friend by paying {B/G}, creating a 1/1 Pest creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Pest, adding {C}{C}.
When the Pest dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with toughness 6 or greater

3784-7500.description:
Activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least six {C} that can't be spend to cast spells from your hand.
Activate Ringing Strike Mastery by paying {5}, untapping Vhal.
Repeat.

3967-4559-7096-7306.easyPrerequisites: You've had two or more lands enter this turn.
3967-4559-7096-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
3967-4559-7096-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Bioengineered Future.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2533-5963-6913.description:
Activate Marvin by sacrificing it, returning Chameleon from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Loyal Retainers.
Activate Chameleon by sacrificing it, returning Marvin from your graveyard to the battlefield, which will have Loyal Retainers' activated abilities.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 7 or greater

3398-7016.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control
3398-7016.description:
Declare Hellkite Charger and Firebending Student as attackers, triggering each of their abilities.
Resolve the Firebending Student trigger, adding an amount of {R} equal to its power.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1129-1978-5056.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Allies.
1129-1978-5056.description:
Cause Harabaz Druid to become an artifact using Neurok Transmuter.
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Harabaz Druid.
Repeat from step 2.

483-3054-3416-5670.easyPrerequisites:
You've gained life this turn if Oathsworn Vampire is in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
483-3054-3416-5670.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire either from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Edgar triggers, creating a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire.
When Oathsworn Vampire dies, Cruel Celebrant triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat steps 3 through 5 once, sacrificing the Vampire token instead.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

339-677-5223-6798.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3504-4608-5466.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Mercurial Pretender.
3504-4608-5466.notablePrerequisites: You control five or more enchantments.
3504-4608-5466.description:
Cast Mercurial Pretender by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Mercurial Pretender into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Mercurial Pretender's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Mercurial Pretender's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent.
Resolve Mercurial Pretender's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 2.

4936-5630-6089-6462.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Moss-Pit Skeleton triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters the battlefield, Skyswimmer Koi and Cloakwood Swarmkeeper trigger.
Resolve the Skyswimmer Koi trigger, drawing Moss-Pit Skeleton from your library, and then discarding it.
Resolve the Cloakwood Swarmkeeper trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1563-4321-4365-5777.description:
Activate Camellia by paying {2} and sacrificing a Food.
Camellia's first ability triggers, creating two Foods and two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Resolve the Camellia ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Squirrel you control.
Activate the two Foods by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

5295-5696-5702.notablePrerequisites:
You have cast your commander from the command zone at least twice.
You have a way to cause a land to enter the battlefield under your control.
5295-5696-5702.description:
Cause a land to enter the battlefield under your control. Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Jyoti.
Put the token Jyoti into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The token Jyoti's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature token for each time you've cast your commander from the command zone this game.
When the Forest Dryads enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers that many times.
Holding priority, activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat step 6 until there is only one Springheart Nantuko trigger remaining.
Resolve the final Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Jyoti.
Repeat from step 2.

1737-2511-4242-4853.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {4} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Su-Chi.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Su-Chi.
When Su-Chi dies, Su-Chi and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Su-Chi trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1117-2034-6263.description:
Cast Junk Diver by paying {3}.
Mendicant Core triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy the Junk Diver spell, creating a token copy of it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Junk Diver, adding {C}{C}.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning another artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the token Junk Diver, adding {C}{C}.
When the token Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning the nontoken Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

261-3000-5670.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
261-3000-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Suture Priest's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1409-1671-2895-5478.manaNeeded: {1}{G}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1409-1671-2895-5478.description:
Cast Uro by paying {1}{G}{U}
When Uro enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities trigger, as well as Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and Uro.
Resolve the second Uro trigger, causing you to draw a card, gain 3 life, and put Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters untapped due to Spelunking, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Uro by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Repeat from step 2.

2732-4050-4681.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide, adding one mana of any color.
When Karmic Guide dies, Prowling Geistcatcher's first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide from your graveyard.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Prowling Geistcatcher, adding one mana of any color.
When Prowling Geistcatcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Prowling Geistcatcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1849-3259-3968.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1849-3259-3968.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Grave Titan as attackers.
Grave Titan triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1737-1822-3094-4636.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {6} and tapping it.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Prototype Portal's ability.
Resolve the copy of Prototype Portal's ability, creating a token copy of Gonti's Aether Heart.
When the Gonti's Aether Heart token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Resolve the original Prototype Portal ability, creating a token copy of Gonti's Aether Heart.
Put either Gonti's Aether Heart token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Gonti's Aether Heart token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Activate the remaining Gonti's Aether Heart token by paying eight {E} and exiling it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders

868-1031-1170-3105.description:
Cast Desperate Ritual by paying {1}{R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Invasion of Arcavios.
When Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, searching your library and/or graveyard for Pyretic Ritual and putting it into your hand.
Resolve Desperate Ritual, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Pyretic Ritual by paying {1}{R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Invasion of Arcavios.
When Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Desperate Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Pyretic Ritual, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

618-719-3320.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Goatnapper with haste.
The Goatnapper token enters the battlefield, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

94-1636-3590.notablePrerequisites:
Warchanter Skald does not have summoning sickness.
Warchanter Skald has at least one Aura and/or Equipment attached.
94-1636-3590.description:
Cast Lightning Volley by paying {3}{R}.
Activate Warchanter Skald by tapping it.
Warchanter Skald triggers, creating a 2/1 Dwarf Berserker creature token.
The Dwarf Berserker enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Warchanter Skald ability from step 2, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.

1117-2034-2465.description:
Cast Junk Diver by paying {3}.
Tawnos triggers, copying the Junk Diver spell.
Both Junk Divers enter the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Junk Diver, adding {2}.
Junk Diver dies, returning any other artifact card from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Junk Diver token, adding {2}.
The Junk Diver token dies, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1586-4191.description:
Cast Silver Drake without paying its mana cost due to Aluren.
When Silver Drake enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
